name: update_event
description:
Update an existing event in the user's Outlook Calendar. Only the provided fields will be modified; omitted fields remain unchanged.

Parameters:
- event_id: The event ID to update (required, from outlook_calendar_search).
- subject: Updated event title.
- start_time/end_time: Updated event start and end timestamps. Use YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events, otherwise use RFC3339 timestamps with the user's timezone offset from viewer context (e.g. 1970-01-31T12:00:00-08:00). Always include the offset — never send bare datetimes.
- timezone: IANA or Windows timezone for the event times. Defaults to UTC.
- description: Updated event body (plain text).
- location: Updated location.
- attendees: Updated attendee list (email addresses). This REPLACES the full attendee list.
- is_online_meeting: Set to true to add a Teams meeting link.
- is_all_day: Set to true to make it an all-day event.

event_id.description: The event ID to update (from outlook_calendar_search).

start_time.description: Updated start time as RFC3339 with timezone offset (e.g. 1970-01-31T12:00:00-08:00), or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events. Always include the user's timezone offset from viewer context.

end_time.description: Updated end time as RFC3339 with timezone offset (e.g. 1970-01-31T13:00:00-08:00), or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events. Always include the user's timezone offset from viewer context.

timezone.description: IANA or Windows timezone (e.g. "America/Chicago"). Always provide this.

attendees.description: Updated list of attendee email addresses. Replaces the full attendee list.

is_online_meeting.description: When true, adds a Teams meeting link.

is_all_day.description: When true, makes it an all-day event.
